threat_model: Outcome files already exist in the repository.
A language model may have memorized historical Moroccan election outcomes.
Candidate and territory names can reveal target year and allow recall.
Live articles may have been updated after the election.
Post-election descriptions can leak winner or loser status.

controls.filesystem_partition: Packet-builder and judge jobs must not mount or checkout target-election outcome files.
controls.anonymization: Randomize party labels independently by election; randomize territory, region and candidate IDs; remove real names, year and dates from judge packets.
controls.mapping_seal: Before judgments, commit only SHA-256 of the canonical anonymization mapping. Keep the mapping outside judge access. Publish it only after judgment hashes are frozen.
controls.packet_hashing: Every packet is canonical JSON and SHA-256 addressed.
controls.outcome_seal: Development and holdout outcomes are opened only by a separate scoring step after corresponding judgment manifests are committed.
controls.internet: C2 and H1 have no browsing, connectors or external tools.
controls.text_redaction: Raw excerpts remain in the evidence archive but judge packets contain only structured verified features and source-rank metadata.
controls.attempt_log: All model attempts, including invalid JSON, are retained.
controls.code_separation: Packet generation, judgment generation, outcome unseal and scoring are separate scripts with distinct CLI modes.
controls.git_diff_guard: CI fails if any immutable F-1/B2/F0/E_collect/Atlas path differs from the exact parent commit.

automatic_invalidation_events: Any real target-election party, territory, candidate or year label appears in a C2 or H1 packet.
Any target-election result or post-election fact appears in a packet.
An anonymization mapping is exposed to the judge before outputs freeze.
A prompt or metric is changed after 2021 outcome access.
Any historical packet is deleted or regenerated after outcome unseal without a new experiment version.
